description: App-only adapter for the team form in the selected salonId. action=create prepares input.staff; update prepares input.staffId and patch; replace_services prepares full replacement of input.serviceIds for staffId. Saves a plan without changing staff or assignments. In conversation, use beautyos_staff_create_prepare, beautyos_staff_update_prepare or beautyos_staff_services_replace_prepare. Apply separately with beautyos_apply_change after explicit confirmation.
name: beautyos_prepare_staff_change
title: UI: staff change preview
